row.body: The house key is clipped to a checklist that says the rooms were cleared; a note on the reverse asks who will collect the owner’s coat.
row.title: Everything accounted for

sidecar.gloss: A completed room checklist leaves a personal item without a named recipient.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field inspection could use the same checklist; the missing coat is not proof of an official search.

row.body: the blue pen and briefcase are wrapped in a child's raincoat. one stayed dry while the other was left in road mud.
row.title: missing count beside the blue pen

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
